key_file = os.environ.get('GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE')
with open(key_file) as f:
    api_key = f.read().strip()

from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
gi = GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', key=api_key)

HISTORY_ID = 'bbd44e69cb8906b5a792b78e71d03018'

# Get dataset IDs for the two zip files
history_contents = gi.histories.show_history(HISTORY_ID, contents=True)
animals_zip_id = None
fungi_zip_id = None
for ds in history_contents:
    if ds['name'] == 'scogs_animals.zip':
        animals_zip_id = ds['id']
    elif ds['name'] == 'scogs_fungi.zip':
        fungi_zip_id = ds['id']

print(f"Animals zip ID: {animals_zip_id}")
print(f"Fungi zip ID: {fungi_zip_id}")

# UDT representation
udt_repr = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "phykit-batch-pis-v1",
    "name": "PhyKIT Batch Parsimony Informative Sites",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/phykit:2.1.94--pyhdfd78af_0",
    "shell_command": (
        "set -eu\n"
        "mkdir -p animals fungi\n"
        'unzip -q "$(inputs.animals_zip.path)" -d animals/ "*.mafft"\n'
        'unzip -q "$(inputs.fungi_zip.path)" -d fungi/ "*.mafft"\n'
        "\n"
        "printf 'group\\tpis_count\\n' > pis_results.tsv\n"
        "\n"
        "# Process animal alignments\n"
        "for f in animals/*.mafft; do\n"
        '    result="$(phykit parsimony_informative_sites \\"$f\\")"\n'
        '    count="$(printf '"'"'%s'"'"' \\"$result\\" | cut -f1)"\n'
        '    printf '"'"'animals\\t%s\\n'"'"' \\"$count\\" >> pis_results.tsv\n'
        "done\n"
        "\n"
        "# Process fungal alignments\n"
        "for f in fungi/*.mafft; do\n"
        '    result="$(phykit parsimony_informative_sites \\"$f\\")"\n'
        '    count="$(printf '"'"'%s'"'"' \\"$result\\" | cut -f1)"\n'
        '    printf '"'"'fungi\\t%s\\n'"'"' \\"$count\\" >> pis_results.tsv\n'
        "done\n"
    ),
    "inputs": [
        {"name": "animals_zip", "type": "data", "format": ["zip"]},
        {"name": "fungi_zip", "type": "data", "format": ["zip"]},
    ],
    "outputs": [
        {"name": "pis_results", "type": "data", "format": "tabular", "from_work_dir": "pis_results.tsv"}
    ],
}

# First, uninstall any existing version
try:
    existing = gi.unprivileged_tools.list_user_tools()
